name: Night stable attendant
design: Huge heavy adult male Yautja, dark reddish-brown spotted hide, broad skull, four distinct massive ivory mandibles, long tied black scalp tendrils. Brown hooded cloak with hood DOWN over dark green work vest and thick rope belt, charcoal apron and wraps. Carries one compact unlit protective-cage bronze lantern close to thigh and a ring of three very large simple stall keys in other hand. No glow, no lantern light or scenery.
